title: A, B, C
summary: Use sentence punctuation in short, meaningful text without treating prose as a key-location drill.
intro: Use sentence punctuation in short, meaningful text without treating prose as a key-location drill.

screens.text: Hold Shift with the little finger of your right hand and press a to type A. Release Shift before the next key.

screens.text: Hold Shift with the little finger of your right hand and press b to type B. Release Shift before the next key.

screens.text: Hold Shift with the little finger of your right hand and press c to type C. Release Shift before the next key.

screens.text: Type each target carefully, then return to the home position before the next one.
